keywords: Function and Graph 2.Equation and Inverse Function 3.Exponential and Logarithmic Function 4.Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Function 5.Limit Value
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) functions and their graphs. (2) equations and inverse functions. (3) exponential functions and logarithmic functions. (4) trigonometric functions and inverse trigonometric functions.
advice: This is a basic course in mathematics and science for engineer. We will cover the following topics: 1. Functions, their graphs, displacement of graphs, and the limit value. 2. Equations and inverse functions. 3. Exponential functions and logarithmic functions. 4. Trigonometric functions and inverse trigonometric functions. Extra classes may be held depending the comprehension level of students. Students are required to review and preview each class. As a matter of particular emphasis, students are required to attempt the exercises after each class. Extra materials may be distributed if necessary. Students are required to show their procedure for solution/calculation logically and clearly in each assignment. Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the instructor.
books: Textbook: Mathematics and Science for Engineer Reference books: Reader of Calculus -1 variable - Engineering Mathematics Text Series - Calculus -
requiredKnowledge: Basic calculation skills of numerical formulas (expansion, factorization, division, and calculation of fractional formula).

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of functions and draw graphs of functions.
Understand the concept of inverse functions and draw graphs of inverse functions.
Understand the concept of exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, and inverse trigonometric functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend every class, and do the required works.
